resources.string: Fine-tune the selected invoice element. Tap ? anytime while this panel is open.

string-array.name: help_topic_element_props_s1
string-array.item: Lock — prevents accidental moves on the canvas. Unlock to edit again.
Binding type — Static shows fixed text/image; Data field pulls live bill values.
Static text — words that never change (e.g. labels like “Total”).
Data field — links to shop name, buyer, line items, totals, invoice number, etc.
Static image — pick a picture from gallery for logos or stamps.
Text prefix — extra text placed before a data value (e.g. “Phone: ”).

string-array.name: help_topic_element_props_s2
string-array.item: Font size — height of text in points on the PDF.
Bold / Italic / Underline — standard text styling.
Font family — typeface used when the PDF is generated.
Font color — hex color (e.g. #212121). Leave blank for default black.

string-array.name: help_topic_element_props_s3
string-array.item: Horizontal align — left, center, or right within the element box.
Vertical align — top, middle, or bottom within the element box.
Image scale — fit inside the box, fill/crop, or stretch to bounds.
Table border width — line thickness around the items table (table elements only).

string-array.name: help_topic_element_props_s4
string-array.item: X / Y — distance from the top-left of the page in dp.
Width / Height — element box size on the invoice.
Apply changes — saves edits to the canvas. Dragging on canvas also updates position.
Delete element — removes the selection from the template.
Bulk edit — when several elements are selected, shared fields update all at once.

resources.string: Configure the line-items table: which columns appear, their labels, and the total row.

string-array.name: help_topic_table_columns_s1
string-array.item: Border width — thickness of grid lines around cells (in dp).
Show total row — adds a summary row at the bottom of the table.
Total row label — text in the first column of the total row (e.g. “Total”).

string-array.name: help_topic_table_columns_s2
string-array.item: Column key — internal field name (qty, mrp, amount, discountAmount, etc.).
Column label — heading printed in the table header row.
Column width — relative width share; wider columns get more space.
Remove (×) — deletes that column from the table.
Add column — inserts a new blank column row to configure.
Apply changes — saves columns and table settings to the template.
